items.stem: A sole trader has unlimited liability for the debts of the business. What does this mean?

options.text: The owner's personal assets can be used to settle business debts
options.rationale: Correct: with unlimited liability there is no legal separation, so personal assets are exposed.

options.text: The business can borrow any amount it wishes
options.rationale: Liability concerns responsibility for debts, not borrowing capacity.

options.text: Liability is capped at the amount of capital introduced
options.rationale: That describes limited liability, not unlimited liability.

options.text: Creditors can only claim against business bank accounts
options.rationale: Creditors are not restricted to business accounts under unlimited liability.

items.explanation: Correct: with unlimited liability there is no legal separation, so personal assets are exposed.

items.stem: Which of the following is a primary purpose of an organisation's internal control system?

options.text: To safeguard assets and ensure the reliability of records
options.rationale: Correct: safeguarding assets and reliable records are core objectives of internal control.

options.text: To guarantee the business makes a profit
options.rationale: No control system can guarantee profitability.

options.text: To replace the need for external audit
options.rationale: Internal control supports, but does not replace, external audit.

options.text: To set the organisation's dividend policy
options.rationale: Dividend policy is a financing decision, not an internal-control objective.

items.explanation: Correct: safeguarding assets and reliable records are core objectives of internal control.

items.stem: Select TWO features that distinguish a limited company from a sole tradership.

options.rationale: Correct: a company is a separate legal person distinct from its owners.
Correct: shareholders' liability is limited to the amount unpaid on their shares.

options.text: No requirement to keep accounting records
options.rationale: Companies must keep accounting records; this is not a distinguishing benefit.

options.text: Profits are automatically exempt from tax
options.rationale: Company profits are subject to tax; they are not exempt.

options.text: Owners cannot be employees of the business
options.rationale: Owners can also be employees/directors of a company.

items.explanation: Correct: a company is a separate legal person distinct from its owners.
